**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (insert at preferred level).**

- **Investigation:** § 3.5 (Effect of Termination) covers only accrued payments; § 11.6 (Content) allocates responsibility for Content; § 14.18 (Data Protection) covers processing instructions only; § 14.2 (Survival) adds no exit duties. Searches for transition, return, migration, deletion returned no exit mechanics anywhere in the Agreement.
- **Classification:** Fails the fallback entirely (no assistance period, no export obligation) in a hosted-services agreement, so an insert is warranted.
- **Cure:** One new § 3.6 inserted after p0049 carrying exactly the six preferred elements — expiry/termination trigger, up to six months' assistance, then-current rates, return within 30 days, machine-readable format, certified deletion after return — drafted with the Agreement's defined term "Content" to avoid an undefined "Customer Data" reference.
